g.text: Cross-cutting. Every controller consults it before
returning data (2.3.6: access rules are enforced on
the server, never by the interface).
Owns the eight-state work-order machine. Every change
to WorkOrder.status passes through this class, including
cancel) — it decides what work should exist and who does
it, but delegates the transition itself, so 8.3.2 is
The system's computational core. Designated Lab 4
